run_cli_main: run the fairchem CLI with a config YAML file using the main entry point
run_cli_on_slurm: run a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster using the main CLI with slurm scheduler mode
run_cli_locally: run a fairchem job locally using the main CLI with local scheduler mode
get_canonical_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
get_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and merge a Hydra config from a YAML file with CLI override arguments
